name: Cline Desktop
desc: Desktop app for running Cline against open-weight models.
desc_zh: 用开源权重模型跑 Cline 的开源桌面应用。
solves: The extension assumes a hosted model provider; this app runs the agent on models you already have locally.
solves_zh: 插件默认你走托管模型服务；这个应用让你用本地已有的模型跑同一个智能体。
best_for: You want the agent on your own hardware because the code cannot leave the machine.
best_for_zh: 代码不能离开本机，想让智能体也在自己的硬件上跑。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — cline.bot/blog directory）。 Early version at launch. Separate surface from the Cline VS Code extension already in the ledger; a Cline CLI and Cline Cloud also exist but no launch announcement with a date was found. 首次公开日期来源：https://cline.bot/blog/cline-desktop-an-open-source-app-for-open-weight-models
